instruction.text: Drag the triangles into the correct places in the Venn diagram.

hint.label: Venn diagram
hint.text:
The triangle with a right angle, but no equal sides, goes in the circle on the right.

The triangle with at least two equal sides, but no right angle, goes in the circle on the left.

The triangle with a right angle and at least two equal sides goes in the middle.

instruction.text: Let’s take a closer look at this triangle. Fill in the gaps in the sentence.

atoms.a: As you can see, this triangle has 2 equal sides, 2 equal angles and a right angle.
atoms.b: This triangle is both a ((++right-angled equilateral)) triangle <u>and</u> an ((++isosceles scalene)) triangle.
atoms.finishSound: This triangle is both a right-angled triangle <u>and</u> an isosceles triangle.

instruction.text: Drag the triangles into the correct places in the Venn diagram.

hint.label: Venn diagram
hint.text:
The triangle with a right angle, but also with two equal angles, goes in the circle on the right.

The triangle with no equal angles, but also with no right angle, goes in the circle on the left.

The triangle with a right angle and no equal angles goes in the middle.

instruction.text: Let’s take a closer look at this triangle. Fill in the gaps in the sentence.

atoms.a: As you can see, this triangle has 0 equal sides, 0 equal angles and a right angle.
atoms.b: This triangle is both a ((++right-angled equilateral)) triangle <u>and</u> a ((isosceles ++scalene)) triangle.
atoms.finishSound: This triangle is both a right-angled triangle <u>and</u> a scalene triangle.

instruction.text: Drag the triangles into the correct places in the Venn diagram.

hint.label: Venn diagram
hint.text:
The triangle with no equal angles, no right angle and no equal sides goes in the top left yellow section.

The triangle with a right angle and no equal angles or sides, goes in the section between the yellow and purple sections.

The triangle with two equal sides and two equal angles, but with no right angles, goes in the bottom blue section.

The triangle with a right angle, but with two equal sides, goes in the section between the purple and blue sections.
